def solve():
    n = 25
    tier1 = min(n, 25)
    tier2 = max(n - 25, 0)
    gross = Q(tier1) * 1200 + Q(tier2) * 2600
    uncapped = Q(500) * 1
    cap = gross * Q("0.2")
    if gross >= 45000:
        applied = min(uncapped, cap)
    else:
        applied = Q(0)
    net = gross - applied
    return {
        "final": net,
        "gross_cost": gross,
        "uncapped_credit": uncapped,
        "applied_credit": applied,
    }
